name: Basil
hook: Stop buying basil. Grow a bushy plant on your windowsill.

steps.title: Full sun or grow light
steps.tip: Give it your brightest window or a sunny balcony. Long, floppy stems mean it needs more light.

steps.title: Keep the soil just moist
steps.tip: Keep the soil evenly moist. Water the soil, not the leaves, ideally in the morning.

steps.title: Pinch above leaf pairs
steps.tip: Snip stems just above a pair of leaves. New shoots sprout there and the plant gets bushier.

steps.title: Remove flower buds
steps.tip: Pinch off flower spikes as soon as they appear to keep the leaves sweet and coming.

steps.title: Keep it warm
steps.tip: Basil turns black in the cold. Keep it indoors once nights fall below 10°C.

steps.title: Root cuttings in water
steps.tip: Root 10 cm shoots without flowers in water, with the lower leaves removed. Pot them up in a few weeks.

outro: Pinch often, pick often. The more you harvest, the more you get.
